en: The exact price is fixed by our server and held for 30 minutes.
target: Den genauen Preis legt unser Server fest und hält ihn 30 Minuten lang.
suggestion: Den genauen Preis legt unser Server fest und reserviert ihn 30 Minuten lang.
explanation: «held» is rendered «hält» here but «reserviert» in ui:quote.heldFor («Preis reserviert für {time}»); the same concept in the same window reads two ways, and «reserviert» states the 30-minute hold more clearly. Meaning is intact — a consistency nuance.
rule: consistency: one source term, one translation within the batch
